data.one_liner: Converts GraphQL queries into REST-compatible POST bodies for any HTTP client.
data.what_it_does: The library transforms GraphQL query strings into a format that can be sent via a standard HTTP POST request. It replaces argument and input placeholders with actual values supplied by a payload object.
use_when: You need to call a GraphQL endpoint using a plain HTTP client like Dio or http.
You want to avoid adding a full GraphQL client dependency to your project.
You need a lightweight solution for converting queries on the fly.
avoid_when: You already use a dedicated GraphQL client such as graphql_flutter or Artemis.
You require automatic response parsing or schema validation.
strengths: No external dependencies beyond Dart SDK.
Works with any HTTP client, including Dio, http, or custom clients.
Simple API with payload classes for arguments and inputs.
weaknesses: Does not handle GraphQL responses or errors automatically.
No schema validation or type safety for queries.
Limited to POST requests; does not support subscriptions or websockets.
